sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
Today, we are going to learn about the Lord’s Supper. When Jesus met with His disciples before He died, they all took the Lord’s Supper together.
1 Corinthians 11:23-29
Luke 22:14-23 (The Lord’s Supper)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
We take the Lord’s Supper to remember what Jesus did for us on the cross.
The bread reminds us of how Jesus’ body was broken, and the drink reminds us of Jesus’ blood that was shed for us.
We should not take the Lord’s Supper in an unworthy manner.
Before we take the Lord’s Supper, we should examine our lives, confess any sin and make the decision to turn from it.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Bring some bread or chapati and some juice or water and take the Lord’s Supper with those in the group who are following Jesus and have been baptized.
Before taking the Lord’s Supper, spend time examining your life, and turn from sin.
If needed, there is extra teaching on the Lord’s Supper available in the back of this book within the “Church Essentials” section.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God desires that His gospel would be known among all people as a testimony. Let’s commit to share it with the world.
Matthew 24:14
Pray
Spend time together thanking Jesus for what He did for us all when He sacrificed His life for us on the cross.
